svg.title: Complete high-level system design
svg.desc: Full architecture diagram showing a client request passing through CDN, load balancer, and API gateway, fanning out to three microservices, each backed by a cache and a sharded replicated database, with services also emitting events to a message queue consumed by background workers
svg.text: health checks, picks a healthy gateway

g.text: Cache layer (Redis) — checked before hitting the database

svg.text: Top spine: synchronous request path, client to database
Right branch: asynchronous path, services fire events and move on
Each service owns its data — no shared database across services
